title: TreeFI: Value-Aware Statistical Fault Injection for Deep Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.04912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliability evaluation of deep neural networks under hardware faults commonly relies on fault injection, but exhaustive campaigns are intractable for modern models and datasets. Statistical fault injection reduces this cost, yet existing approaches still require large injection budgets because they do not explicitly exploit a key property of floating-point faults: the effect of a bit flip depends strongly on the value being corrupted. We propose TreeFI, a value-aware statistical fault-injection methodology for FP32 single-bit faults in DNN activations and weights. TreeFI partitions each layer's value distribution into intervals with similar expected bit-flip behavior, learned using regression trees, and allocates injections across these intervals according to their relevance for failure-rate estimation. This stratified allocation preserves the target confidence and error margin while avoiding unnecessary injections in low-impact region

translated_title: TreeFI：面向深度神经网络的价值感知统计故障注入方法
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络在硬件故障下的可靠性评估通常依赖于故障注入，但对于现代模型和数据集而言，穷举式的故障注入实验是难以实现的。统计故障注入降低了这一成本，然而现有方法仍然需要较大的注入预算，因为它们未能明确利用浮点故障的一个关键特性：位翻转的影响在很大程度上取决于被损坏的值本身。我们提出了TreeFI，一种面向深度神经网络激活值和权重中FP32单比特故障的价值感知统计故障注入方法。TreeFI利用回归树将每一层的值分布划分为具有相似预期位翻转行为的区间，并根据这些区间对故障率估计的相关性来分配注入。这种分层分配方式在保持目标置信度和误差范围的同时，避免了在低影响区域进行不必要的注入。
tldr: TreeFI提出了一种价值感知的统计故障注入方法，通过回归树将神经网络各层的值分布按位翻转影响程度分区并分层分配注入预算，在保证目标置信度和误差精度的同时显著减少深度神经网络可靠性评估所需的故障注入次数。
en_tdlr: TreeFI is a value-aware statistical fault-injection methodology that uses regression trees to partition DNN value distributions into intervals with similar bit-flip behavior and stratifies injection allocation accordingly, preserving target confidence and error margins while avoiding unnecessary injections in low-impact regions.
